name: Braintrust
summary: Braintrust is a commercial platform for evaluating and observing AI applications and agents. It combines experiments that compare prompts and models, production tracing and logging, scorers and annotation, plus an in-product agent (Loop) that analyzes traces and helps write evals. It is a hosted service, with a self-hosted data plane available for enterprise deployments.
facts: TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, C#
goodFor: Eval-driven development of prompts and agents
Comparing models and prompts side by side
Teams wanting evals and tracing in one tool
watchOut: Short data retention on lower tiers (14–30 days)
